rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese word for an invented, familiar, shortened, or diminutive name.

example.english: When I was little, my classmates gave me a nickname.
example.traditional: 我細個嗰陣，班同學改咗個花名畀我。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 baan1 tung4 hok6 goi2 zo2 go3 faa1 meng2 bei2 ngo5
